notes.title: 【Online mode now available】The 0.9.9 version is here!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! Time flies so fast. After two months of hard work, the 0.9.9 version of Master Of Pottery has finally been developed. Now you can get the latest update on Steam! This update focuses on updating the online mode, now you can share your work with other players! At the same time, some optimizations and changes have been made to the existing system. The detailed updates are as follows:[/h3]

New: Online mode, you can visit each other's showroom with friends or other players in this mode. After another player purchases your work, you will get online mode currency, which can be used to exchange for unique decoration materials, and Visiting a friend’s showroom will receive a random amount of monetary rewards.

The online mode opening conditions: the number of exhibited works is not less than 5, and the number of days is greater than 35.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/484dfb00ac717726ca82892cb5cc67c503545e22.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/7eb3038d1aa5ddf0d9a7c60322c23aff0ff15b2c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/785e5e2eb4fcb948a0b855156e05e63f3a75ec7e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/7bb48d68ca01702a2a8aa7575bbbb385c8edf825.jpg[/img]

New: a exchange store includes a new floor, booth and rest area, and a [touch screen] that displays the current exhibits in real time has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/290eb11e0bbe2e0592c0ae8f26e53db7f8fcddfc.jpg[/img]

New: a background music in online mode.

Optimization: Added an automatic backup system, which automatically generates backup archives and automatically loads them when the main archive is damaged, reducing the possibility of a few players' archives disappearing.

Optimization: Fixed some known bugs.

notes.title: A temporary maintenance for the Chinese version
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Master Of Pottery was firstly released in 2019, and I have received lots of feedback from you. I am surprising to see that so many players have spent such a long time having fun with it. It is your passion that motivates me to keep update the game for free in the past 1 years. Thanks very much.

In order to provide Chinese players with a better game. I would temporarily remove the game in mainland China for a few months. And will soon bring it back after the maintenance is over.

[i][b]Please be noticed that this only affect the players in mainland China. And for those who have own the game, you can still play the game in the Steam library.[/b][/i]

Thanks very much for your understanding, and I am look forward to the day we meet again with Chinese players.

notes.title: 2020.6.29 Major update
notes.notes:
[h3]Weather system:[/h3]
You can make, display, and sell works in 4 weather types: sunny, cloudy, light rain, and heavy rain. All 3d scenes will change with the weather, and more types of weather may be added in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/0e09df1a01a6beb9e0ccf10bf6ee1f5bc4fe89f9.jpg[/img]

[h3] Decoration system: [/h3]
You can buy different styles of decoration materials in the decoration shop, including walls, exhibition booths, floors, roofs, plants, seating areas, etc., and change the appearance of the exhibition hall through different combinations. There are not many decoration materials at present, and new materials will be gradually updated in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/74aa2afb7580047a7b19a7bbc64b6fcfb426e483.jpg[/img]

[h3]Apprentice system:[/h3]
Brand new simulation business gameplay! After your reputation (showroom heat) reaches a certain value, you may receive [Apprentice Letter], after enrolling apprentices, you can use your existing works to teach them (just give your work to them), the apprentice will Imitate your works to create, with the increase of experience, the apprentice's craft becomes stronger. Eventually, the apprentice will give you a gift [raw material] after the apprenticeship, which will be used to purchase decoration assets, and will also increase your reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36088335/bced59624dbaa552725a2276decf977c4650c23d.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Steam achievements you need are here[/h3]

[h3]New materials, music, interface, small functions, waiting for you to discover[/h3]
